stem.text: Solutions X and Y both have a concentration of $0.10\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$. A fixed volume of solution X is added to a conical flask, and solution Y is added from a burette to the conical flask. A titration is performed.
The diagram shows the pH titration curve for the acid–base reaction between the solutions.

stem.alt: Graph of pH (0 to 14) against volume of solution Y/cm^3. The curve starts at about pH 11, falls gently, then drops steeply to about pH 1 and levels off.
